title: Jawaan ki laash uthana bohot hi mushkil hai
body:
Jawa'n ki laash uthana bohot hi mushkil hai phir usko khaime mein laana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
jawa'n ki laash...
1. Hussain seena e akbar se khaich lenge sina..(2)
sina jigar se chhudana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kiya hai teer se asghar ko zibha zalim ne..(2)
yaqeen maa ko dilana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai zakhm itne sakina ke jism par sajjad..(2)
badan se kurta chhudana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Itne tukdo mein bati laasha e qasim bann mein..(2)
chunke ek gathdi mein laana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kahaa ye sughra se abid ne zakhm itne hai..(2)
tujhe gale se lagana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ali ki beti ko aati hai sharm shauhar se..(2)
nisha'n rasan ke dikhana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hijaab mein bhi na jaaye sharif zaadi jaha'n..(2)
bina rida waha'n jaana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Teri kareemi hai sajjad ghar me qatil ko..(2)
bulake khaana khilana, bohoht hi mushkil hai
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Nauhakhwano pe hai bibi ka karam aye farhaan..(2)
warna ye nauha sunana bohot hi mushkil hai
jawa'n ki laash
